properties.name: Balears
properties.selection: purposive: dense cells, most large-roof area
properties.note: Chosen by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --priority as a place to start: among the cells holding Spain's densest quarter of buildings (from 138 bldg/km2), the 1 km window with the most roof area in buildings of 1,000 m2 or more (159 such buildings, 61.9 ha of roof; 287 buildings in all, 287 per km2, VIDA). Large and dense roofs are where rooftop solar is most likely; the box was chosen on buildings only, never on solar seen there. Esri imagery here dates from 2025-09-14 (oldest of centre and corners), no older than 2025-05-01 for a composite starting 2026-05-01. Not checked on the ground: confirm it is mappable before you start, and do not move it toward visible solar.
